title: 384 Well Plate PCR Preparation for cDNA Samples
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Configure protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Set the following parameters before running the OT‑2: number of cDNA tubes (max 5), number of mastermix tubes, cDNA volume and mastermix volume such that their sum equals 20 µL per well, choose whether mastermix is added in triplicates across columns (new/box method) or across whole columns (original), set Dispense Flow Rate (default 1, optional 0.5 or 1.2), set Blowout Flow Rate (default 1, optional 0.5 or 1.2), decide if tip racks should be reset at the start of the run, and select the P20 single‑channel mount (left or right).

steps.title: Transfer cDNA in triplicates
steps.instruction: Using the P20 pipette on the chosen mount, dispense the specified cDNA volume into each well of a column in triplicate (three consecutive wells per column) for each cDNA sample, covering up to the number of columns equal to the number of mastermix tubes. Apply the configured Dispense Flow Rate and Blowout Flow Rate, and follow the OT‑2 tip‑tracking (reset tip racks only if prompted).

steps.title: Add mastermix to populated columns
steps.instruction: Dispense the specified mastermix volume into each well of the same columns that received cDNA, up to the populated rows. Use the same Dispense Flow Rate and Blowout Flow Rate settings as for cDNA, and continue tip tracking as configured.
